reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing memory/context management tool for DeepSeek Harness, centered on visualizing model context and allowing controlled edits to conversation surface content. The README shows a dedicated Context UI tab plus a POST /ctm control API for replace/delete/rollback/restore/undo operations and optional real-application of edits into session logging, so its impact is on context transparency, editing, and session-state behavior rather than external service integrations or file/terminal actions.

summaries.zh: dsh-ctm 是 DeepSeek Harness 的上下文透明度插件，在对话界面提供可查看与编辑上下文的入口，并支持替换、删除、回滚与恢复等会话操作。
summaries.en: dsh-ctm is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a context-focused chat interface for inspecting and editing conversation context, including controls for replace, delete, rollback, and restore actions.

capabilities: Provides a Conversation Context tab for viewing turn/segment history and token usage
Exposes POST /ctm operations to replace, delete, rollback, restore, and undo context segments
Supports replacing the initial system prompt and overriding segment effectiveness values
Can apply edits to the session log in host pipeline when enabled (agent/pre-step)
Computes and displays token/accounting summaries from session projections or full-log fallback
